item.title: Building Scalable API Architecture
item.description:
When building modern applications, API architecture decisions can make or break your system’s ability to scale. The difference between a well-designed API and a poorly architected one becomes painfully obvious when traffic spikes hit.

The Foundation

RESTful principles provide a solid starting point, but real-world scalability requires going beyond textbook implementations. Resource-based URLs, proper HTTP methods, and consistent response formats are table stakes.

Key Considerations

Rate limiting prevents abuse while allowing legitimate traffic to flow. Versioning strategies ensure backward compatibility as your API evolves. Caching layers reduce database load and improve response times.
